pattern: \[Win32App\] Content cache miss for app \(id = {GUID}, name = (?<name>.*?)\), start downloading
description: Captures 'Content cache miss for app (id = <guid>, name = <name>), start downloading...' (ContentManager.cs) as a secondary app-name source. Fires right before a real download begins, so it resolves names for exactly the apps that will produce download/install activity — a redundancy for IME-POLICIES-based naming after IME retired the old name-bearing processing lines.
